title: Arkret Authenticated Signer Resolution Evidence
description: Content-addressed immutable signer-key resolution material retained for historical verification. The evidence ref is derived from the SHA-256 digest of the complete RFC 8785 JCS object; callers never substitute a current resolver result.

signer_evidence_ref.description: ak:signer_evidence:sha256:<hex>, where hex is SHA-256(RFC8785-JCS(complete evidence object)).

service_signer_evidence.description: The signed ServiceResolutionRecord, method-native history evidence and normalized DID document are retained together. signer_id equals record.service_id and verification_method is authorized by the retained normalized document at the signed record history position. Durable historical signer evidence permits only did:key or a complete did:webvh history; did:web is forbidden because a mutable web document cannot close historical verification. Record route expiry is checked at admission time but does not retroactively invalidate retained evidence. Complete canonical evidence is at most 1 MiB.

normalized_did_document.description: Exact normalized DID document whose digest and history position are authenticated by public_resolution.method_history_evidence.

principal_signer_evidence.description: attester_signer_evidence_ref/digest resolves to a service-kind leaf that historically verifies the Principal Server projection attestation. Current route or DID expiry is not a retrospective validity input.

native_agent_signer_evidence.description: The four required ref/digest pairs resolve the Agent Authority, controller, Account Authority and receiver historical signer leaves selected by the exact methods in agent_signer_evidence. Each ref content digest equals its paired digest. Current route or DID expiry is not a retrospective validity input.
